findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "quote_trip" is 10026 chars, far longer than this server's median (1284). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quote_trip, get_trip_car · Public sink: quote_trip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quote_trip, get_trip_car · Public sink: quote_trip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
